mapper.select: SELECT t1.device, SUM(t1.cnt) AS total_cnt, ROUND(SUM(t1.cnt) * 100.0 / IFNULL(MAX(t2.total_cnt), 1), 2) AS ratio_value FROM t_link_device_stats t1 JOIN ( SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM t_link_device_stats WHERE full_short_url = #{fullShortUrl} AND date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND del_flag = 0 ) t2 WHERE t1.full_short_url = #{fullShortUrl} AND t1.date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND t1.del_flag = 0 GROUP BY t1.device ORDER BY total_cnt DESC
